Use case: ui-mockup / compositing.
Make ONE polished medieval fantasy game UI mockup in the exact same 2:1 landscape aspect ratio as image 1. Image 1 is an actual game screenshot with the notification temporarily hidden: EDIT TARGET / BACKPLATE. Image 2 is the actual existing goblin guest Graz portrait: SUPPORTING INSERT, reuse its face, costume, pose, green skin, cooking-pot helmet, sword exactly; crop/scale existing illustration.
Task: design ONLY the SMALL NON-MODAL NPC TALK INVITATION WIDGET on the LEFT side of normal gameplay. This is the little notification BEFORE opening a conversation, NOT the conversation dialog itself. Do not make a central dialog, no shade over gameplay, no reply choices, no large panel, do not change the scene or invent a new environment.
LOCK THE BACKPLATE: lodge, snowy forest, characters, camera, player status in top left, objective plaque at x35..275 y155..230, timer, resources, bottom card hand and workbench, all existing HUD are unchanged. New widget must be confined to x25..470 y270..475, directly BELOW the existing objective, NOT overlapping it. Outside this small area preserve every pixel of image 1. Make widget visibly tidy and unified, with a clear silhouette and consistent padding. Match hand-drawn fantasy HUD: muted brass edge, deep plum, warm cream, restrained turquoise accents; fine crafted details, no massive ornaments, no neon, no modern mobile app style. Text 16-22px at source 1774px screenshot width and readable. Entire widget is ONE clear click target, counts and wait progress must belong to the same frame rather than float outside.
Exact Korean copy available: name "그라즈", spoken invitation "마녀님! 마녀님!", action "이야기 듣기" with small right chevron, queue badge "2", countdown "떠나기까지" and a thin remaining-time indicator (no invented numerical time). You may use these as required by layout below. No concept labels, no external annotations.
DIRECTION A — COMPACT HORIZONTAL INVITATION CARD (recommended practical direction). One elegant compact wide card around x28..450 y275..423 (422w,148h). Dark matte plum panel with subtle brass hairline and softly clipped corners, simple stable silhouette. Inside left a 90x105 portrait inset cropped to bust (not full-height sprawling cutout), right column starts at x150: name "그라즈" on header left, a small circular count badge "2" at top right; spoken invitation in warm-ivory text on second line; footer small "이야기 듣기  ›" in pale turquoise. At bottom a very thin muted-gold remaining-time track plus tiny "떠나기까지" integrated INSIDE card, neither outside nor under character. All right column elements align to one start. No speech tail, no separate giant button. Clear hierarchy name small, spoken invitation main, action footer secondary. Keep widget compact and leave center gameplay open.
